# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Master  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P58](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0058)</sub>; Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is a sarcastic, overbearing, and ineffective disciplinarian who stokes resentment in his pupils. He occasionally displays sudden, arbitrary impulses to enforce discipline, yet often avoids the effort of punishing larger groups, preferring instead to make a public example out of an individual student.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Overbearing  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- Ineffective  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching algebra

## Goals

- Preparing older students for Regent's examinations  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

During his term as master of Brierley School, Mr. Pidgeon was helping Sukey Pullen with algebra when Hugh Carrow provoked Nell Harcourt into smashing her slate over Hugh's head. Intervening in the commotion, Mr. Pidgeon ignored Hugh's admission of fault and made a public spectacle of Nell by forcing her to stand before the blackboard with a chalked inscription reproving her poor temper. The next day, after a sudden impulse to strictly enforce punctuality, he found Nell arriving late alongside the boys. To preserve his reputation without disciplining the whole group, he mocked her and forced her to sit beside Hugh, which caused Nell to leave the school entirely for home instruction. According to local gossip, Mr. Pidgeon was considered a poor instructor who ignored younger children to focus solely on his Regent's candidates and maintained disgraceful discipline, retaining his job only through his uncle's control of the school trustees.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P43](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0043), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P45](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0045), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Background by volume

- Secured his position as a schoolteacher through the influence of his uncle, a powerful trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Lodged at the home of Eben Duckett during his time as master  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
